result.instructions: Tools for Finale Inventory, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How much stock do we have of SKU WIDGET-01 across locations?"; "Which purchase orders are open with our suppliers?"; "Show sales orders updated this week with their dates and totals.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Finale Inventory data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run finale_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run finale_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run finale_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. finale_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: finale_list_facilities
tools.title: List locations (facilities)
tools.description: List Finale locations and sublocations: facilityName, facilityUrl (use it in other tools), parentFacilityUrl (set for sublocations), status. GET /{account}/api/facility/.

updated_since.description: Only records last updated on or after this UTC time. Finale allows a range of at most 30 days (updated_until defaults to now).

updated_until.description: Only records last updated on or before this UTC time (needs updated_since).

fields.description: Fields to return per row (default: a compact useful set).

tools.name: finale_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products (SKUs): productId, internalName, status, productUrl, manufacturer, UPC, packing. Optional exact filters on productId and status. Collections come back ordered by lastUpdatedDate; for large catalogs narrow with updated_since or page with next_updated_since. GET /{account}/api/product/.

status.description: Only active or only inactive products.

updated_since.description: Only records last updated on or after this UTC time. Finale allows a range of at most 30 days (updated_until defaults to now).

updated_until.description: Only records last updated on or before this UTC time (needs updated_since).

fields.description: Fields to return per row (default: a compact useful set).

tools.name: finale_get_product
tools.title: Get a product
tools.description: One product in full: ids, description, UPC/ASIN, dimensions and weight, cost, supplier list, reorder guidelines, price list, custom fields. GET /{account}/api/product/{id} (falls back to a productId filter when the resource URL differs).

product_id.description: The product id (SKU) as shown by finale_list_products.

tools.name: finale_list_orders
tools.title: List orders (sales and purchase)
tools.description: List orders without their line items: orderId, type (SALES_ORDER or PURCHASE_ORDER), status (ORDER_CREATED, ORDER_LOCKED = committed, ORDER_COMPLETED, ORDER_CANCELLED), dates, origin/destination facility, reference number, total. Get the items with finale_get_order. For a large order history always pass updated_since (Finale cuts unfiltered collections at 120,000 rows before applying other filters). GET /{account}/api/order/.

order_type.description: Only sales or only purchase orders.

updated_since.description: Only records last updated on or after this UTC time. Finale allows a range of at most 30 days (updated_until defaults to now).

updated_until.description: Only records last updated on or before this UTC time (needs updated_since).

fields.description: Fields to return per row (default: a compact useful set).

tools.name: finale_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: One order in full: header, line items (productUrl, quantity, unitPrice), roles (customer or supplier), adjustments, shipment and invoice URLs, notes. GET /{account}/api/order/{orderId}.

order_id.description: The order id as shown by finale_list_orders (orderId).

updated_since.description: Only records last updated on or after this UTC time. Finale allows a range of at most 30 days (updated_until defaults to now).

tools.name: finale_get_shipment

tools.title: List customers and suppliers
tools.description: List party groups (customers, suppliers, carriers): partyId (derived from partyUrl; use it as supplier_party_id when drafting a purchase order), name (description), type, roles, status. GET /{account}/api/partygroup/.

updated_since.description: Only records last updated on or after this UTC time. Finale allows a range of at most 30 days (updated_until defaults to now).

tools.name: finale_list_inventory_items
tools.title: List stock entries
tools.description: Current stock as Finale stores it: one entry per product, location, lot and order with quantityOnHand, quantityOnOrder (committed purchase orders) and quantityReserved (committed sales orders). The inventoryitem collection has no server-side filter, so the WHOLE collection is downloaded (one collection read of the 300 per hour; can be large on big accounts, up to the 50,000 character result cap) and filtered here: pass product_id or facility_url. For per-product totals use finale_get_product_stock. GET /{account}/api/inventoryitem/.

product_id.description: Only entries of this product id (SKU).

facility_url.description: Only entries at this facilityUrl (from finale_list_facilities).

fields.description: Fields to return per row (default: a compact useful set).

tools.name: finale_get_product_stock
tools.title: Get stock levels of a product
tools.description: Stock of one product summed over Finale's stock entries: totals for quantityOnHand, quantityOnOrder and quantityReserved, and the same per location/sublocation. Downloads the WHOLE inventoryitem collection (Finale offers no filter; large on big accounts), so it counts as one collection read of the 300 per hour: avoid calling it in a loop. GET /{account}/api/inventoryitem/.

annotations.title: Get stock levels of a product

tools.name: finale_create_draft_purchase_order
tools.title: Create a draft purchase order (WRITE)
tools.description: WRITE. Creates a purchase order for a supplier in status ORDER_CREATED, i.e. an editable draft. It is NOT locked (committed), received, completed or emailed, no stock changes and no money moves: review and commit it in Finale. Products are looked up first (one single read each; products whose resource URL differs from the SKU cost collection reads, bounded to 3 or one full product-list read), then ONE POST creates the order; the call is never retried, so check finale_list_orders before repeating it after an error. POST /{account}/api/order/.

product_id.description: Product id (SKU); it is looked up in Finale first, an unknown id stops the whole request.

unit_price.description: Unit cost for this purchase (omit to leave it to Finale).

destination_facility_url.description: Receiving location's facilityUrl (from finale_list_facilities; not a sublocation). Omit for 'Multiple / unspecified'.

order_id.description: Order id (max 20 ASCII characters; must be unique). Omit to let Finale number it.
